WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, WAREHOUSING_NO, WAREHOUSING_YEAR, SEQ, WAREHOUSING_DATE, WAREHOUSING_TYPE, ORDER_NO, ORDER_SEQ , VENDOR_CODE, MAKER_NAME, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, LAN, POUCH, PERMIT_DATE, CLEARLANCE_NO, CSTMS, CSTMS_RATE, ORIGIN_NATION, AMOUNT_FOREIGN , UNIT_PRICE_FOREIGN, EXCHANGE_DATE, EXCHANGE_RATE, BL_NO, BL_QUANTITY, WAREHOUSING_QTY, WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, ASSETS_TYPE, UNIT, UNIT_PRICE) VALUES (P.COMPANY_CODE, P.DIVISION_CODE, P.WAREHOUSING_NO, P.WAREHOUSING_YEAR, P.SEQ, P.WAREHOUSING_DATE, P.WAREHOUSING_TYPE, P.ORDER_NO, P.ORDER_SEQ , P.VENDOR_CODE, P.MAKER_NAME, P.ITEM_CODE, P.ITEM_NAME, P.LAN, P.POUCH, P.PERMIT_DATE, P.CLEARLANCE_NO, P.CSTMS, P.CSTMS_RATE, P.ORIGIN_NATION, P.AMOUNT_FOREIGN , P.UNIT_PRICE_FOREIGN, P.EXCHANGE_DATE, P.EXCHANGE_RATE, P.BL_NO, P.BL_QUANTITY, P.WAREHOUSING_QTY, P.WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT, P.CURRENCY, P.ASSETS_TYPE, P.UNIT, P.UNIT_PRICE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SALES_LEDGER_INF (COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, SALES_LEDGER_NO, SALES_LEDGER_YEAR, SALES_LEDGER_SEQ, SALES_DATE, ITEM_MOVE_TYPE, ASSETS_TYPE, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, HS_CODE, CUSTOMER_CODE, QUANTITY, UNIT, AMOUNT, PROD_ID) VALUES (#{COMPANY_CODE}, #{DIVISION_CODE}, #{SALES_LEDGER_NO}, #{SALES_LEDGER_YEAR}, #{SALES_LEDGER_SEQ}, #{SALES_DATE}, #{ITEM_MOVE_TYPE}, #{ASSETS_TYPE}, #{ITEM_CODE}, #{ITEM_NAME}, #{HS_CODE}, #{CUSTOMER_CODE}, #{QUANTITY}, #{UNIT}, #{AMOUNT}, #{PROD_ID})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO SALES_LEDGER T USING ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, SALES_LEDGER_NO, SALES_LEDGER_YEAR, SALES_LEDGER_SEQ, SALES_DATE, ITEM_MOVE_TYPE, ASSETS_TYPE, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, HS_CODE, CUSTOMER_CODE, QUANTITY, UNIT, AMOUNT, PROD_ID FROM SALES_LEDGER_INF A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ) P ON (T.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE AND T.DIVISION_CODE = P.DIVISION_CODE AND T.SALES_LEDGER_NO = P.SALES_LEDGER_NO AND T.SALES_LEDGER_YEAR = P.SALES_LEDGER_YEAR AND T.SALES_LEDGER_SEQ = P.SALES_LEDGER_SEQ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.SALES_DATE = P.SALES_DATE ,T.ITEM_MOVE_TYPE = P.ITEM_MOVE_TYPE ,T.ASSETS_TYPE = P.ASSETS_TYPE ,T.ITEM_CODE = P.ITEM_CODE ,T.ITEM_NAME = P.ITEM_NAME ,T.HS_CODE = P.HS_CODE ,T.CUSTOMER_CODE = P.CUSTOMER_CODE ,T.QUANTITY = P.QUANTITY ,T.UNIT = P.UNIT ,T.AMOUNT = P.AMOUNT ,T.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (COMPANY_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, SALES_LEDGER_NO, SALES_LEDGER_YEAR, SALES_LEDGER_SEQ, SALES_DATE, ITEM_MOVE_TYPE, ASSETS_TYPE , ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, HS_CODE, CUSTOMER_CODE, QUANTITY, UNIT, AMOUNT, PROD_ID, CREATE_DATE, REMNDR_QY) VALUES (P.COMPANY_CODE, P.DIVISION_CODE, P.SALES_LEDGER_NO, P.SALES_LEDGER_YEAR, P.SALES_LEDGER_SEQ, P.SALES_DATE, P.ITEM_MOVE_TYPE, P.ASSETS_TYPE , P.ITEM_CODE, P.ITEM_NAME, P.HS_CODE, P.CUSTOMER_CODE, P.QUANTITY, P.UNIT, P.AMOUNT, P.PROD_ID, SYSDATE, P.QUANTITY)
